Field.content:
class Field (F : Type) where
  zero_F    : F
  one_F     : F
  add_F     : F → F → F
  mul_F     : F → F → F
  opp_F     : F → F
  inv_F     : F → F

  add_comm    : ∀ x y, add_F x y = add_F y x
  add_assoc   : ∀ x y z, add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z)
  add_zero    : ∀ x, add_F x zero_F = x
  add_inv_l   : ∀ x, add_F (opp_F x) x = zero_F

  mul_comm    : ∀ x y, mul_F x y = mul_F y x
  mul_assoc   : ∀ x y z, mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z)
  mul_one_l   : ∀ x, mul_F one_F x = x
  mul_inv_l   : ∀ x, x ≠ zero_F → mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F

  distrib_l   : ∀ x y z, mul_F x (add_F y z) = add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z)

  zero_neq_one : zero_F ≠ one_F
  inv_nonzero  : ∀ x, x ≠ zero_F → inv_F x ≠ zero_F

add_cancel_l.content:
theorem add_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x + y = x + z → y = z := by
  intro H
  have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => -x + w) H
  change -x + (x+y) = -x + (x+z) at H₁
  rw [← add_assoc]       at H₁
  rw [add_inv_l]         at H₁
  rw [add_comm]          at H₁
  rw [add_zero]          at H₁
  rw [<- add_assoc, add_comm, add_inv_l]          at H₁
  rw [add_zero]          at H₁
  exact H₁

add_cancel_r.content:
theorem add_cancel_r (x y z : F) : y + x = z + x → y = z := by
  intro H
  rw [add_comm y x, add_comm z x] at H
  apply add_cancel_l
  assumption

mul_cancel_l.content:
theorem mul_cancel_l (x y z : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : x * y = x * z → y = z := by
  intro H
  have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => inv_F x * w) H
  change inv_F x * (x * y) = inv_F x * (x * z) at H₁

  rw [← mul_assoc]        at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]      at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]          at H₁
  rw [← mul_assoc]        at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]      at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]          at H₁

  exact H₁

mul_cancel_r.content:
theorem mul_cancel_r (x y z : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : y * x = z * x → y = z := by
  intro H
  rw [mul_comm y x, mul_comm z x] at H
  apply mul_cancel_l x y z h
  assumption

inv_unique.content:
theorem inv_unique (x y : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) (H : x * y = one_F) : y = inv_F x := by
  have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => inv_F x * w) H
  change inv_F x * (x * y) = inv_F x * one_F at H₁
  rw [← mul_assoc]    at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]  at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]      at H₁
  rw [mul_comm]       at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]      at H₁
  exact H₁

inv_involutive.content:
theorem inv_involutive (x : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : inv_F (inv_F x) = x := by
  apply Eq.symm
  apply inv_unique
  · exact inv_nonzero x h
  · exact mul_inv_l x h

isSolvable_of_isScalarTower.content:
axiom isSolvable_of_isScalarTower : ∀ {F K : Type} {p q : polynomial F},
  IsSolvable (Gal p) → IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F K))) → IsSolvable (Gal q)

isSolvable_map_poly.content:
axiom isSolvable_map_poly : ∀ {F K : Type} (p : polynomial F),
  IsSolvable (Gal p) → IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)))

isSolvable_of_splits.content:
axiom isSolvable_of_splits : ∀ {F K : Type} (p : polynomial F) (f : F → K),
  Splits p f → IsSolvable (Gal p)

gal_isSolvable_tower.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_tower
  (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
  (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p))))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal q) := by
  apply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower hp hq

gal_isSolvable_double_tower.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_double_tower
  (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
  (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
  (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q))))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal r) := by
  have Hq := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower hp hq
  apply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hq hr

gal_isSolvable_triple_tower.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_triple_tower
  (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
  (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
  (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
  (hs : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly s (@algebraMap F (SplittingField r))))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal s) := by
  have Hq := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower hp hq
  have Hr := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hq hr
  apply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hr hs

gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower
  (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
  (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
  (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
  (hs : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly s (@algebraMap F (SplittingField r)))))
  (ht : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly t (@algebraMap F (SplittingField s))))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal t) := by
  have Hq := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower hp hq
  have Hr := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hq hr
  have Hs := isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hr hs
  apply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower Hs ht

gal_isSolvable_map_poly.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_map_poly (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p)) :
  IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))) := by
  apply isSolvable_map_poly p hp

gal_isSolvable_of_split.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_of_split
  (hsplit : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal p) := by
  apply isSolvable_of_splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)) hsplit

gal_isSolvable_split_tower.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_split_tower
  (hsplit : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal q) := by
  apply isSolvable_of_splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)) hsplit

gal_isSolvable_two_step_map.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_two_step_map (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p)) :
  IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) (@algebraMap K L))) := by
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  exact hp

gal_isSolvable_three_step_map.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_three_step_map {M : Type}
  (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p)) :
  IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly (map_poly (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))
                                           (@algebraMap K L))
                                 (@algebraMap L M))) := by
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  exact hp

gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p)) :
  IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) (@algebraMap K L))) := by
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  exact hp

gal_isSolvable_mutual_split.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_mutual_split
  (hsplit_p : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))
  (hsplit_q : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal p) ∧ IsSolvable (Gal q) := by
  constructor
  · apply isSolvable_of_splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)) hsplit_p
  · apply isSolvable_of_splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)) hsplit_q

gal_isSolvable_tower_split.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_tower_split
  (hsplit_q : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
  (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q))))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal r) := by
  apply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower
  · apply isSolvable_of_splits
    exact hsplit_q
  · exact hr

gal_isSolvable_map_after_split.content:
theorem gal_isSolvable_map_after_split
  (hsplit : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p))) :
  IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))) := by
  apply isSolvable_map_poly
  apply isSolvable_of_splits
  exact hsplit

add_cancel_l.content:
Lemma add_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x + y = x + z -> y = z.
  Proof.
    intros H.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => - x + w)) in H.
    rewrite <- !add_assoc in H.
    rewrite !add_inv_l in H.
    rewrite add_comm in H.
    rewrite !add_zero in H.
    rewrite add_comm in H.
    rewrite !add_zero in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

add_cancel_r.content:
Lemma add_cancel_r (x y z : F) : y + x = z + x -> y = z.
  Proof.
    intros H.
    rewrite (add_comm y x) in H.
    rewrite (add_comm z x) in H.
    apply add_cancel_l in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

mul_cancel_l.content:
Lemma mul_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x <> 0 -> x * y = x * z -> y = z.
  Proof.
    intros Hnz Heq.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => inv_F x * w)) in Heq.
    rewrite <- !mul_assoc in Heq.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in Heq; [| assumption].
    rewrite mul_one_l in Heq.
    rewrite mul_one_l in Heq.
    exact Heq.
  Qed.

mul_cancel_r.content:
Lemma mul_cancel_r (x y z : F) : x <> 0 -> y * x = z * x -> y = z.
  Proof.
    intros Hnz H.
    rewrite (mul_comm y x) in H.
    rewrite (mul_comm z x) in H.
    apply (mul_cancel_l x y z Hnz) in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

inv_unique.content:
Lemma inv_unique (x y : F) : x <> 0 -> x * y = 1 -> y = inv_F x.
  Proof.
    intros Hnz He.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => inv_F x * w)) in He.
    rewrite <- !mul_assoc in He.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in He; [| assumption].
    rewrite mul_one_l in He.
    rewrite mul_comm in He.
    rewrite mul_one_l in He.
    exact He.
  Qed.

inv_involutive.content:
Lemma inv_involutive (x : F) : x <> 0 -> inv_F (inv_F x) = x.
  Proof.
    intros Hnz.
    apply eq_sym.
    apply inv_unique.
    - apply inv_nonzero; assumption.
    - apply mul_inv_l; assumption.
  Qed.

SplittingField.content:
Variable SplittingField  : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.
  Variable algebraMap      : forall {F K : Type}, F -> K.
  Variable Splits          : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> Prop.
  Variable map_poly        : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> polynomial K.
  Variable Gal             : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.

algebraMap.content:
Variable algebraMap      : forall {F K : Type}, F -> K.
  Variable Splits          : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> Prop.
  Variable map_poly        : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> polynomial K.
  Variable Gal             : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.

Splits.content:
Variable Splits          : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> Prop.
  Variable map_poly        : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> polynomial K.
  Variable Gal             : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.

map_poly.content:
Variable map_poly        : forall {F K : Type}, polynomial F -> (F -> K) -> polynomial K.
  Variable Gal             : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.

Gal.content: Variable Gal             : forall {F : Type}, polynomial F -> Type.

p.content: Variables p q r s t : polynomial F.

q.content: Variables p q r s t : polynomial F.

r.content: Variables p q r s t : polynomial F.

s.content: Variables p q r s t : polynomial F.

t.content: Variables p q r s t : polynomial F.

map_poly_comp.content:
Axiom map_poly_comp :
    forall {F K L : Type} (p : polynomial F)
           (f : F -> K) (g : K -> L),
      map_poly (map_poly p f) g
      = map_poly p (fun x => g (f x)).

isSolvable_of_isScalarTower.content:
Axiom isSolvable_of_isScalarTower :
    forall {F K : Type} {p q : polynomial F},
      IsSolvable (Gal p) ->
      IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F K))) ->
      IsSolvable (Gal q).

isSolvable_map_poly.content:
Axiom isSolvable_map_poly :
    forall {F K : Type} (p : polynomial F),
      IsSolvable (Gal p) ->
      IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))).

isSolvable_of_splits.content:
Axiom isSolvable_of_splits :
    forall {F K : Type} (p : polynomial F) (f : F -> K),
      Splits p f -> IsSolvable (Gal p).

gal_isSolvable_tower.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_tower
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
          (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
        : IsSolvable (Gal q).
  Proof. eapply isSolvable_of_isScalarTower; eauto. Qed.

gal_isSolvable_double_tower.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_double_tower
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
          (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
          (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
        : IsSolvable (Gal r).
  Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField p) p q hp hq) as Hq.
    apply (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField q) q r); assumption.
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_triple_tower.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_triple_tower
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
          (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
          (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
          (hs : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly s (@algebraMap F (SplittingField r)))))
        : IsSolvable (Gal s).
  Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField p) p q hp hq)  as Hq.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField q) q r Hq hr) as Hr.
    apply (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField r) r s); assumption.
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
          (hq : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))))
          (hr : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
          (hs : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly s (@algebraMap F (SplittingField r)))))
          (ht : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly t (@algebraMap F (SplittingField s)))))
        : IsSolvable (Gal t).
  Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField p) p q hp hq)  as Hq.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField q) q r Hq hr) as Hr.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField r) r s Hr hs) as Hs.
    apply (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField s) s t); assumption.
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_map_poly.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_map_poly
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
        : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))).
  Proof. apply (isSolvable_map_poly p hp). Qed.

gal_isSolvable_of_split.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_of_split
          (hsplit : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
        : IsSolvable (Gal p).
  Proof. apply (isSolvable_of_splits p _ hsplit). Qed.

gal_isSolvable_split_tower.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_split_tower
          (hsplit : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
        : IsSolvable (Gal q).
  Proof. apply (isSolvable_of_splits q _ hsplit). Qed.

gal_isSolvable_two_step_map.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_two_step_map
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
        : IsSolvable
            (Gal (map_poly (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) (@algebraMap K L))).
    Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly F K p hp) as H1.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly K L (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) H1) as H2.
    exact H2.
    Qed.

gal_isSolvable_three_step_map.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_three_step_map
          {M : Type}
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
        : IsSolvable
            (Gal
               (map_poly
                  (map_poly
                     (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))
                             (@algebraMap K L))
                             (@algebraMap L M))).
  Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly F K p hp) as H1.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly K L (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) H1) as H2.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly L M
                   (map_poly (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K)) (@algebraMap K L)) H2) as H3.
    exact H3.
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp
          (hp : IsSolvable (Gal p))
        : IsSolvable
            (Gal
              (map_poly
                 (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))
                 (@algebraMap K L))).
  Proof.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_map_poly F K p hp) as H1.
    exact (isSolvable_map_poly
            (F := K) (K := L)
            (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))
            H1).
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_mutual_split.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_mutual_split
          (hsplit_p : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))
          (hsplit_q : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
        : IsSolvable (Gal p) /\ IsSolvable (Gal q).
  Proof.
    split.
    - apply (isSolvable_of_splits p _ hsplit_p).
    - apply (isSolvable_of_splits q _ hsplit_q).
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_tower_split.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_tower_split
          (hsplit_q  : Splits q (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
          (hr        : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly r (@algebraMap F (SplittingField q)))))
        : IsSolvable (Gal r).
  Proof.
    pose proof (isSolvable_of_splits q _ hsplit_q) as Hq.
    pose proof (@isSolvable_of_isScalarTower F (SplittingField q) q r Hq hr) as Hr.
    exact Hr.
  Qed.

gal_isSolvable_map_after_split.content:
Theorem gal_isSolvable_map_after_split
          (hsplit : Splits p (@algebraMap F (SplittingField p)))
        : IsSolvable (Gal (map_poly p (@algebraMap F K))).
  Proof.
    pose proof (isSolvable_of_splits p _ hsplit) as Hp.
    apply (isSolvable_map_poly p Hp).
  Qed.

add_comm.content: add_comm    : forall x y, add_F x y = add_F y x;

add_assoc.content: add_assoc   : forall x y z, add_F (add_F x y) z = add_F x (add_F y z);

add_zero.content: add_zero    : forall x, add_F x zero_F = x;

add_inv_l.content: add_inv_l   : forall x, add_F (opp_F x) x = zero_F;

mul_comm.content: mul_comm    : forall x y, mul_F x y = mul_F y x;

mul_assoc.content: mul_assoc   : forall x y z, mul_F (mul_F x y) z = mul_F x (mul_F y z);

mul_one_l.content: mul_one_l   : forall x, mul_F one_F x = x;

mul_inv_l.content: mul_inv_l   : forall x, x <> zero_F -> mul_F (inv_F x) x = one_F;

distrib_l.content: distrib_l   : forall x y z, mul_F x (add_F y z) = add_F (mul_F x y) (mul_F x z);

inv_nonzero.content: inv_nonzero  : forall x, x <> zero_F -> inv_F x <> zero_F;

lean.statement: theorem add_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x + y = x + z → y = z := by
lean.proof:
intro H
  have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => -x + w) H
  change -x + (x+y) = -x + (x+z) at H₁
  rw [← add_assoc]       at H₁
  rw [add_inv_l]         at H₁
  rw [add_comm]          at H₁
  rw [add_zero]          at H₁
  rw [<- add_assoc, add_comm, add_inv_l]          at H₁
  rw [add_zero]          at H₁
  exact H₁

coq.statement: Lemma add_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x + y = x + z -> y = z.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros H.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => - x + w)) in H.
    rewrite <- !add_assoc in H.
    rewrite !add_inv_l in H.
    rewrite add_comm in H.
    rewrite !add_zero in H.
    rewrite add_comm in H.
    rewrite !add_zero in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem add_cancel_r (x y z : F) : y + x = z + x → y = z := by
lean.proof:
intro H
  rw [add_comm y x, add_comm z x] at H
  apply add_cancel_l
  assumption

coq.statement: Lemma add_cancel_r (x y z : F) : y + x = z + x -> y = z.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros H.
    rewrite (add_comm y x) in H.
    rewrite (add_comm z x) in H.
    apply add_cancel_l in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem mul_cancel_l (x y z : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : x * y = x * z → y = z := by
lean.proof:
intro H
  have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => inv_F x * w) H
  change inv_F x * (x * y) = inv_F x * (x * z) at H₁

  rw [← mul_assoc]        at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]      at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]          at H₁
  rw [← mul_assoc]        at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]      at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]          at H₁

  exact H₁

coq.statement: Lemma mul_cancel_l (x y z : F) : x <> 0 -> x * y = x * z -> y = z.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros Hnz Heq.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => inv_F x * w)) in Heq.
    rewrite <- !mul_assoc in Heq.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in Heq; [| assumption].
    rewrite mul_one_l in Heq.
    rewrite mul_one_l in Heq.
    exact Heq.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem mul_cancel_r (x y z : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : y * x = z * x → y = z := by
lean.proof:
intro H
  rw [mul_comm y x, mul_comm z x] at H
  apply mul_cancel_l x y z h
  assumption

coq.statement: Lemma mul_cancel_r (x y z : F) : x <> 0 -> y * x = z * x -> y = z.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros Hnz H.
    rewrite (mul_comm y x) in H.
    rewrite (mul_comm z x) in H.
    apply (mul_cancel_l x y z Hnz) in H.
    exact H.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem inv_unique (x y : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) (H : x * y = one_F) : y = inv_F x := by
lean.proof:
have H₁ := congrArg (fun w => inv_F x * w) H
  change inv_F x * (x * y) = inv_F x * one_F at H₁
  rw [← mul_assoc]    at H₁
  rw [mul_inv_l _ h]  at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]      at H₁
  rw [mul_comm]       at H₁
  rw [mul_one_l]      at H₁
  exact H₁

coq.statement: Lemma inv_unique (x y : F) : x <> 0 -> x * y = 1 -> y = inv_F x.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros Hnz He.
    apply (f_equal (fun w => inv_F x * w)) in He.
    rewrite <- !mul_assoc in He.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in He; [| assumption].
    rewrite mul_one_l in He.
    rewrite mul_comm in He.
    rewrite mul_one_l in He.
    exact He.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem inv_involutive (x : F) (h : x ≠ zero_F) : inv_F (inv_F x) = x := by
lean.proof:
apply Eq.symm
  apply inv_unique
  · exact inv_nonzero x h
  · exact mul_inv_l x h

coq.statement: Lemma inv_involutive (x : F) : x <> 0 -> inv_F (inv_F x) = x.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros Hnz.
    apply eq_sym.
    apply inv_unique.
    - apply inv_nonzero; assumption.
    - apply mul_inv_l; assumption.
  Qed.
